purpose: End-to-end calibration of the scientific validation gates using a deterministic repository fact.

claim.text: The active CEREBRON farm registry contains exactly 74 farms with integer IDs 1 through 74, with no duplicate IDs and no duplicate repository names.
claim.scope: config/farms.json at the packet source commit

reproduction_protocol.independent_method: Read config/farms.json and recompute all five checks without trusting E2.

reality_gate_protocol.pass_condition: Claim C1 exactly matches independently recomputed repository state.
reality_gate_protocol.fail_condition: Claim exceeds or disagrees with observed repository state.

ablation_protocol.remove_E2: C1 must remain independently verifiable from E1.
ablation_protocol.remove_E1: Do not promote C1 solely from the workflow statement E2.
ablation_protocol.pass_condition: E1 is sufficient for recomputation and E2 is corroborative rather than sole evidence.

transfer_protocol.target: Apply the same validator to a synthetic registry fixture with a duplicate ID or duplicate repo.
transfer_protocol.note: Transfer PASS requires an actually executed fixture test; specification alone is PENDING.

required_outputs.F59: ablation PASS/FAIL and transfer PASS/FAIL with executed observations
